name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

hideProgress.description: Whether to show the progress of steps for this step

label.description: The value to display in the multi step header for this step

componentId.description: The {@link UiSdlComponent#id} to render in the step

retrieveNextStep.description: Spec describing the transitions between the current step and other steps in the component

continueText.description: The content to display on the primary (continue) button

backText.description: The content to display on the secondary (back) button

cancelText.description: The content to display on the link (cancel) button

saveText.description: The content to display on the link (apply and save) button
